description: Create a recurring care schedule (water/fertilize/custom). Scope it to a plant (its active planting), a bed, or the whole garden. Recurrence is EITHER everyDays (e.g. 3) OR weekdays (e.g. ['monday','thursday']). Use when the user wants a repeating watering/feeding reminder. Optionally end it on a date (endsOn) or after N completions (endsAfter); use at most one.

bed.description: Scope to this bed (optional; ignored if plant is given).

endsAfter.description: Optional: stop after this many completions. Use at most one of endsOn / endsAfter.

endsOn.description: Optional last date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); no task after it. Use at most one of endsOn / endsAfter.

everyDays.description: Repeat every N days (1–365). Use this OR weekdays.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

plant.description: Scope to this plant's active planting (optional).

startDate.description: First due date YYYY-MM-DD; default today.

weekdays.description: Repeat on these weekdays, e.g. ['monday','thursday']. Use this OR everyDays.

name: set_care_schedule
title: Set a care schedule
